newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 29.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 30 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two rail blasts in southern Russian towns were both launched by the same Chechen terrorists, who do not seem to be under the control of the separatist authorities.
- Russia's biggest state bank Sberbank holds three quarters of the population's savings.
- The head of military intelligence service is likely to resign. The name of his possible replacement is still being negotiated between top military officials.

- Russians will spend 16 percent of their total income this year on housing and municipal services and by 2000 the figure will grow to 20 percent, according to a new housing reform which starts on May 1.
- "Roditi", which opened one of the first western style supermarkets in Moscow, has been declared bankcrupt.
